html_title: SEA — Characterization of a Catalase-Negative Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Strain

semantic_spot_checks.check: Catalase-negative MRSA was confirmed as S. aureus subsp. aureus and carried a five-base catalase-gene deletion causing frameshift/premature termination; SEA states this without broadening to prevalence or causality.
SEA preserves 98.6%/97.8% commercial identification probabilities and 99.60%/99.54% catalase-gene sequence identities.
SEA preserves that no infection was apparent, no other patients yielded the strain, and pathogenicity/transmission implications remain uncertain.
No figures, tables, algorithms, workflows, appendices, or supplements are present.
